description: Header types and schema copies bundled with fair-bioheaders-java, by FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification release (docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md). 'types' is the header-type registry: one row per type this reader knows, with the URL key rules V1-V3 match, the file key used in 'current'/'releases', the status ('released' for a contract published under a release tag with a row in the shared schemas/versions.json, 'draft' for a development contract readable only through the rule V7 opt-in lane), the transport (embedded-header for a file-bound ';~'/'#~' header, embedded-records for records carried inside another type's header under an x- key) and, for a draft, the pinned bytes under 'draft'. 'current' are the copies of the specification main that raw-main URLs select; the release named there is the one they belong to. Each release entry points at a frozen copy of that release's schema. One draft row is registered (FHT): FHT has no released schema, no w3id alias and no entry in the shared schemas/versions.json registry, so its bytes are readable ONLY through the explicit rule V7 opt-in, only at the pinned commit and digest recorded in the row, and only with a warning on every record read that way; registering the row is not a support or release claim (docs/STATUS.md, docs/CAPABILITY-MATRIX.md). FHGM is not registered at all - it is not a header type, and its model-level rules are not implemented here. A draft row never appears under 'current' or 'releases'.

draft.source: FHT-Specification (development repository; no released contract, no w3id alias, no row in the shared schemas/versions.json)

draft.carrierContract: FHGFF3 1.1 (specification v0.5.0, sha256 20ce320f5d706f11ed21cdece4dfb56e3568b50be126e25b4016f46f2e8e416c) is the base schema the draft suite was observed against; the released copy in this jar is byte-identical to it
draft.source: FHGM-Specification (development repository; no released contract, no schemaVersion, no w3id alias, no row in the shared schemas/versions.json). FHGM records carry no schema field: they ride inside an FHGFF3 header under x-fhgm-models (FORMAT.md R15), so this row names the record contract, the transport overlay and the carrier type - the file is still routed by its own FHGFF3 citation under V1-V3.
